subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should `secrets.reload` continue refusing automatic channel restarts during crash-loop safe mode, or may it restart accounts that an operator manually started under suppression?
rationale: The branch changes a documented lifecycle contract introduced with the breaker; code review cannot safely choose that operator-facing recovery policy without Gateway-owner intent.

options.title: Preserve the current contract
options.body: Keep the source/assignment startup repair but remove safe-mode automatic restarts from `secrets.reload`, leaving explicit `channels.start` as the only override.

options.title: Approve account-aware restarts
options.body: Explicitly adopt the new running-account restart contract and require exact-head service proof for stop timeout, rollback, retry, and delivery behavior.

options.title: Choose the sibling candidate
options.body: Pause this PR and select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 if its current head, proof, and mergeability provide the safer narrow landing path.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current contract
recommendation.body: Keep the source/assignment startup repair but remove safe-mode automatic restarts from `secrets.reload`, leaving explicit `channels.start` as the only override.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the persisted breaker and the existing safe-mode reload contract now being changed.
